📺 Mixed-ish (2019–2021)

Mixed-ish follows a young Rainbow Johnson as she grows up in the 1980s after her family leaves a peaceful hippie commune and moves into suburban life. Alongside her parents, Paul and Alicia, and her younger siblings, Johan and Santamonica, Rainbow must adjust to public school, make new friends, and discover where she belongs. As a biracial child navigating different cultures and expectations, she encounters challenges involving identity, family traditions, and fitting in. With hilarious situations, heartfelt family moments, and important life lessons, Mixed-ish explores childhood, acceptance, friendship, and the importance of embracing what makes you unique. Serving as a prequel to Black-ish, the series offers a funny and touching look at Rainbow’s early years.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creators: Kenya Barris, Peter Saji & Tracee Ellis Ross

source_details.synopsis: Mixed-ish (stylized as mixed·ish) is an American single-camera sitcom created by Kenya Barris, Peter Saji and Tracee Ellis Ross that aired on ABC from September 24, 2019, to May 18, 2021. The series is a prequel to Black-ish, and the second series to be spun off from the parent series after the Freeform series Grown-ish. In May 2020, the series was renewed for a second season, which premiered on January 26, 2021. In May 2021, the series was canceled after two seasons.
